findings.claim: The new core module frontend/src/components/appshell/CardFileMenu.tsx, which holds the page menu, every list removal, the re-read and the Continue/history writes for both core apps, is not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: The one place that decides which card leaves which list, sends dismissContinueItem/deleteWatchProgress and applies re-read overrides was never named for invariant planning, so a reader of the spec would look for that logic in VideoApp/ReadingApp/ShelfBlock/useRemovableItems and miss it.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/appshell/CardFileMenu.tsx (new, 510 lines): useCardFileMenu holds PageState trashed/removed/overrides, onRemoveFromContinue calls dismissContinueItem, onRemoveFromHistory calls deleteWatchProgress (lines ~18-22 import), handleReRead calls getShelves; touch points list only ShelfBlock.tsx and usePaged.ts under appshell.

bucket_proposal.reason: Touch-point list omission; no declared invariant is broken by the file existing.

findings.proposed_fix: Add appshell/CardFileMenu.tsx to the SPEC-CORE-157 touch points, noting it as a new deleteWatchProgress/dismissContinueItem caller under the design-decisions watch-history rule.

findings.claim: The new addon module addons/knowledge/frontend/cardMenu/PageFileMenu.tsx, a second page-menu implementation that calls deleteWatchProgress and getShelves, is not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: A new watch-history deletion call site in the addon is outside the planned reach; the spec states the addon 'keeps no menu of its own', yet the addon now owns a full menu host and list-state store parallel to the core one.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/cardMenu/PageFileMenu.tsx: usePageFileMenu, useCardMenuHandlers, PageFileMenuView with onRemoveFromHistory -> deleteWatchProgress(file.id); reRead -> getShelves(file.drive,{by:'all',ids:[id]}). frontend/src/__tests__/watchHistoryCallSites.test.ts now lists it as a caller.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned reach; behavior appears consistent with I1/I3/I10.

findings.proposed_fix: Add cardMenu/PageFileMenu.tsx to the SPEC-ADDON-164 touch points.

findings.claim: addons/knowledge/frontend/NotesPage.tsx is changed to own the Notes page menu and its removal state, but it is not a touch point, while the planned owner notesapp/Home.tsx is left unchanged.
findings.impact: The spec says notesapp/Home.tsx holds the removals and re-reads; the code holds them in NotesPage across Home and Library, so a fix guided by the spec would land in the wrong file.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/NotesPage.tsx:50-54 usePageFileMenu({scope, hasProfile, historyListKeys:['continue']}) and the PageFileMenuProvider wrap; notesapp/Home.tsx absent from the diff.

bucket_proposal.reason: Touch-point list names a different owner than the code.

findings.proposed_fix: Replace notesapp/Home.tsx with NotesPage.tsx in the touch points.

findings.claim: addons/knowledge/frontend/library/pane/useNoteData.ts gains a revision input that re-loads the pane's note, and it is not in the touch-point list.
findings.impact: The pane's note read now also runs after a rename or move from the menu; useLoad.retry may draw the pane's loading state, a behavior change of the pane not planned in the touch points.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/frontend/library/pane/useNoteData.ts:32-41 useNoteData(noteId, revision) calls retry() when revision changes; NotePaneContainer passes revision from NotesLibrary paneRevision.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned reach in the pane; I10 is served by it rather than broken.

findings.proposed_fix: Add library/pane/useNoteData.ts to the touch points.

findings.claim: The watch-history guard test frontend/src/__tests__/watchHistoryCallSites.test.ts has its allow-list widened from one caller to three, outside the touch points.
findings.impact: A rule guard for design-decisions 'removal only on an explicit user action' was relaxed without the spec naming it, so a later unintended caller in either new file passes the guard.

bucket_proposal.reason: Guard change outside the planned reach; callers seen are menu-only.

findings.claim: FileContextMenu gains a fifth optional prop, immediateRows, that is not among the planned 'three optional callbacks and the optional beforeChange gate'.
findings.impact: Rows run their handler in the click rather than on the next frame for every caller that opts in; this API surface is not covered by I8's description or the touch point.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/FileContextMenu.tsx: immediateRows?: boolean; rows = immediateRows ? items.map(i=>({...i, immediate:true})) : items; passed by CardFileMenu and PageFileMenuView.

bucket_proposal.reason: Unplanned API in a listed file; default false preserves existing callers.
